angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill get-off burst vs NFL get-off and pressure rate; year-standardized; yardstick = no-tracking forecast (pick, weight, EDGE share, NGS score, official 10-yd split and 3-cone) fit leave-one-class-out; used as a day-3/undrafted tiebreaker
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest 0.5 s of sideways acceleration (g) on the Run-the-Hoop lap, z within Combine year; shortlist = day-3/undrafted AND top third of class
headline_number: Day-3/undrafted shortlist matched its no-tracking pressure forecast (7.3% vs 7.3%) while the rest of day 3 fell short (5.7% vs 6.9%); 8 of 15 vs 8 of 32 beat the forecast, gap +28 points (90% 4 to 50), shrinking to +20 (-8 to 47) time-forward and +18 (-7 to 47) after selection reweighting; Mantel-Haenszel OR 2.8 (1.0 to 7.6), p 0.16. Drill burst to pressure: -0.02 points per sd (-0.66 to 0.65).
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 14 cand_1 (8.25) applying the round-14 judges' transferable top_changes: short title and a 57-word lede built on a calibration framing (shortlist on forecast, rest below) with a single verdict ('small, uncertain edge; tiebreaker, not a grade'); new survivorship selection model (logistic P(30+ rushes) from pick, role, weight, Hoop G) with inverse-probability-weighted gap and exclusions reported (29 unscored, 9 shortlisted); class-stratified Mantel-Haenszel test; shortlist calibration; drill-burst equivalence bound (rules out more than about 0.65 points per sd); 'Two real boards' worked case with rookie contract APY (Johnson vs Jean-Baptiste, where the rule was right; Kennard vs Sorrell, where it was wrong) plus a matched-board tally (8 of 15) in the text; 2026 Combine protocol (second hoop run 0.37 -> 0.54, burst would need about 7 reps); tracked 40 clip-start issue quantified (tracked split 0.28 s slow, r 0.43 vs official) to justify official split in the yardstick; 2025 games-played availability column and differentiated plans; ridge, drop-best, Bayesian and relabelling rows moved to the appendix; Fig 1 rebuilt as a hero figure sorted by outcome with filled/open hit-miss markers, per-class hit rates and a price panel; burst reliability printed on the chain figure. 1,937 words, 4 figures + 4 tables.
open_risks: The rule was chosen after earlier rounds saw the Hoop G slope (best of 14 screened pairs, search-adjusted p 0.10); only the 2026 class is a clean test.
The stricter versions (time-forward, selection-weighted) and the class-stratified test (p 0.16) all have intervals crossing zero; the matched-board tally is 8 of 15, a coin flip per decision.
Small counts (15 vs 32) and Hoop G reliability from only 10 linemen with two runs (0.37).
No visible in-game mechanism for Hoop G (first-second burst 0.07, 1.5 s depth 0.04); no blockers or injury data, availability only from games played.
Worked boards are illustrative and one of the two pairs (Johnson) is the best shortlisted outcome; the text pairs it with a miss (Kennard) and the 8 of 15 tally to offset selection.
